newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Callaway raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Callaway raised to buy.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist analyst Shelly Hale Young said in written research she has raised her rating on Callaway Golf Co to buy from hold.
-- She upped her earnings estimate for the calendar year 1996 to $1.74 a share from $1.69 and her 1997 estimate to $2.08 a share from $1.90.

-- Hale Young said she lowered her rating to hold in April due to concerns about slowing revenue growth and contracting gross margins. But after retail checks, talks with competitors and a review of new products, she believes those concerns are no longer warranted.
